lines.t: In this town, on your twelfth birthday, the Mayor gives you one million dollars.
One rule. Spend every cent in twenty-four hours. No giving it away. One cent left, and you lose it all.
Today I turned twelve.
Hour one. I bought every candy in the candy shop. The big screen said: nine hundred ninety-nine thousand left.
That's when I realised. A million is a lot.
Hour three. I bought the ice cream truck. With Mister Frosty still inside. He works for me now.
Hour six. I bought my friend Benny a hotel. He asked for a pool on the roof. Done.
Hour nine. I bought the game show. Now I'm the host and the winner.
Mrs. Pickles sold me a rock for a hundred thousand dollars. She said it was lucky.
Hour twenty-three. The screen said: twelve dollars and forty cents left. And every shop was closed.
Except one. Mrs. Pickles' lemonade stand. One lemonade: twelve dollars and fifty cents.
I was ten cents short. She said rules are rules.
One minute left. Benny checked his pockets. Nothing. The whole town started counting down.
Then I remembered. Mister Frosty works for me.
I paid his salary. Twelve dollars and forty cents. Zero left!
The crowd went wild. The Mayor lifted the golden trophy.
And Mister Frosty said: thanks, boss. But my pay is only twelve thirty-nine. Here is your change.
One cent.
One cent left, and you lose it all.
The Mayor took back the candy, the truck, the hotel and the game show.
I got to keep the lucky rock. It is not lucky.
What would you buy first? A or B?
